content: <thought>After searching the template catalog with the functional group “ketones” broken, none of the returned templates correspond to the Wolff‑Kishner reduction (they either involve oxygen‑containing products or do not generate a ketone). To locate the correct template, I will broaden the search by increasing the result limit and then filter for a retrosynthetic template whose left‑hand side (the product) is a simple alkane (no heteroatoms) and whose right‑hand side contains a carbonyl (C=O), which is characteristic of the Wolff‑Kishner reduction. Once such a template is identified, I will retrieve its `mapped_rxn` and `template_id` and return them.
